title: Roadmap debate step structured output
$comment: The debate step is part of the PRESERVED adversarial-debate mechanism: a structured debate facilitator runs N rounds between the two roadmap variants and emits a convergence assessment. The tool-write rewrite changes ONLY the prompt/output contract (markdown -> structured JSON rendered deterministically); the semantic_layer.py module is byte-untouched. Like the diff step, debate carries NO roadmap_ids and therefore has NO §MVR §3 / Contract #3 phantom-ID subset constraint -- the executor routes it through the PLAIN render_step_tool_write (not the id-check variant). The two frontmatter fields (convergence_score, rounds_completed) are the DEBATE_GATE-required fields; convergence_score additionally bears the DEBATE_GATE convergence_score_valid semantic check (float in [0.0, 1.0]).
